instruction: Add a second register bank for more configuration space

edits.name: reg_bank1
edits.reason: copy of an instance the parent already has

paraphrases: Add a second register bank for more configuration space
Clone the config registers into the spare bus slot
notes: Scale-up only ever clones an IP the parent already has. The clone lands on the spare fabric port m3, which drops the placeholder tie-offs that were holding it. 0x20003000 is right because the fabric decodes paddr[13:12], so port 3 answers at offset 0x3000.
